name: TripCraft
description: TripCraft is a spatio-temporally coherent travel planning benchmark dataset that incorporates real-world constraints such as public transit schedules, events, attraction categories, and user personas. It enables detailed trip itinerary generation with spatio-temporal consistency and introduces novel evaluation metrics to assess LLM-generated travel plans across temporal, spatial, sequential, and personal dimensions.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark that has not yet seen broad community adoption, but it addresses a practical travel-planning setting with realistic constraints.
notes: Introduces novel evaluation metrics for travel planning and uses real-world constraints for enhanced personalization.
